scripts.dev: pnpm --filter edge db:local && concurrently -k -n edge,web "pnpm --filter edge dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter edge db:remote && pnpm --filter edge deploy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --parallel typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: vitest run --project packages && pnpm --filter edge test
